test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster pair.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) QU - VZ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/685685746fc1d620ead1be1de835b11bec2bd324b145031d5d49425a37e48717.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0713487a98aebc1543ff0bd6d20f6d8cbe366ccdb4685de89b3877f5e70b24f.png] 

Option 2) OS - TX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59a8abef519a208af80877d8709444ce573548f4879a1d1dcd55b109934f6377.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a1f9ac18b4b174badd85abef0b629f5518b5c49c7dd7a5360b2796d5bdee2bc4.png] 

Option 3) JL - MK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75fceb03911568e074772f90a5f1364be74a4d87144ea3fe71e2e13565559e25.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c9d0f177e83ac7f19887370120c4d9a26c4121cb434f1d194719de07afcdbc9.png] 

​Option 4) EI - JN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f32414ce28eabacc2315b89243e12baadf3b6cc3da11d4360e40f11a05b5283.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d24adbaa5ca81defad80ae04e44422f95689eaa271c917c9f16c2166a436acc.png] 

Thus, out of all 'JL - MK' is the odd one out.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
